R7AH-bear-backcountry-0001.name: 1.5 km W of Nina Creek
R7AH-bear-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AH-bear-backcountry-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Thutade FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), 110 m N: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2023 (fire G60666), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
S facing slope, 10 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland right here: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Germansen Landing, about 16 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Thutade FSR.
Park: 55.83009, -124.88553, pull off on Thutade FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 10 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,282 m, about 336 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 200 m W of the spot at 1,091 m (55.91595, -124.95391). Water: unnamed wetland 150 m E (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-38, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-07-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AH-bear-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-38: about 298 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
